Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.bus

Class BusFrames

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.bus.BusFrames
public final class BusFrames extends Object
The bus wire format, version 1: one JSON object per frame, in a canonical field order shared with the browser codec and pinned by bus-frames-corpus.json.

The SSE transport writes each frame as event: bus, id: <seq>, data: <frame>; the WebSocket transport sends one frame per text message.

Example:

String f = BusFrames.pub("ops.jobs", Json.of(payload), true, 7); // {"v":1,"type":"pub","topic":"ops.jobs","payload":{...},"retained":true,"seq":7} JsonMap up = BusFrames.decode(text); // BusRefusal bus:bad-frame when malformed

Since:
10.0.0

    • encode

      public static String encode(Map<String,?> frame)
      Encodes a frame given as a map, in canonical field order, omitting absent optional fields.
      Parameters:
      frame - The frame (type required; v is always written as 1).
      Returns:
      The encoded frame.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - On an unknown type, or when topic, code or message is missing or not a string, or retained is not a boolean.

    • decode

      public static JsonMap decode(String text) throws BusRefusal
      Decodes and validates one frame. The result holds only the known fields of its type, in canonical order.
      Parameters:
      text - The frame text (strict RFC 8259 JSON).
      Returns:
      The frame.
      Throws:
      BusRefusal - bus:bad-frame when the text is not a valid version-1 frame.
